evidence.quote: Counter at the full $40 million, allocating $36 million to automatic class payments and $4 million to fees.
Hargrove Lane’s latest proposal totals $35 million, within Brightline’s $40 million authorization and lower than the other counsel’s current proposals.

summary: Fees and class relief appeared together in the opening term sheets and were negotiated before settlement. Whitcombe Reyes expressly allocated the available total between class payments and fees. Defense chose Hargrove Lane’s lower-priced proposal over competing counsel’s proposals; the record does not show fee-interest leverage, plaintiff self-dealing, or a misleading declaration.
